documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Notice Of Annual General Meeting Along With Annual Report For FY 2025-26

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported strong Q1 FY27 results with year-on-year growth of 27% in revenue, 55% in EBITDA, and 64% in PAT, driven by operational rigor and execution. Management highlighted that construction equipment demand remains robust while large agricultural equipment is experiencing a cyclical bottom with recovery anticipated. The company maintains a healthy net cash position of approximately INR190 crores and continues to evaluate inorganic acquisition opportunities alongside ongoing capacity enhancements.

guidance.claim: The company stated that FY27 revenue growth is expected to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that leading OEMs indicate calendar year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment, with recovery expected through calendar year 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that after 3 consecutive years of volume decline in small agriculture equipment, some recovery in unit volumes is beginning to be seen.
demand_outlook.quote: After 3 consecutive years of volume decline, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes and the direction of growth is encouraging.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, aligned with capacity enhancement, productivity improvement, and customer-led growth initiatives.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Customer supply from the Ludhiana facility finishing shop restoration has remained uninterrupted while the project progresses on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule. And I'm pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations remain on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

margins_costs.claim: Material consumption cost is noted to be at 33.3%, largely driven by product mix change, alongside a small inventory gain of approximately INR1 crore.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change. There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains that cycle EBITDA margins are about 20% over a cycle from peak to trough.
margins_costs.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough. We maintain that.

margins_costs.claim: Management indicated that material costs typically range between 34% to 37% in their business.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book stands robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at approximately INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash generated during the quarter was INR44 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation continues to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices led customers and channel partners to moderate purchases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the fabrication vertical to become a meaningful vertical within the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: Mexico revenue for FY27 is projected to be in the mid-single-digit million dollar level.
management_commitments.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.
